takeaways.text: **Usage and Watch for on both Overview pages**: On the Overview page and each account's Overview, you can now see how much of your allotment you've used and which meter is closest to its cap, with the Accounts card showing both for every account side by side.
**Usage and Watch for on Resources**: On the Resources page's All tab, every resource now has Usage, Watch for and Trend 7d columns, so you can compare resources and spot the one nearest a limit.

**Opens instantly from cache**: When you reopen usageflare, the dashboard now draws right away from your last visit and quietly refreshes in the background, and the status bar shows "Synced just now" once the numbers update.
**Public landing page, dashboard at /app**: Visiting the site root now shows a landing page, the dashboard lives under /app, and old links like /limits and /resources redirect there.
**Bulk labels**: On the Resources page, select rows, groups or every row and use the floating bar's **Labels…** button to add or remove labels on many resources at once, with Undo.

**Usage dashboard on real Cloudflare data**: On the Overview page and under each account in the sidebar, you can now see bill so far, forecast, limits at risk and a resource breakdown for every account your tokens reach.
**Bulk labels**: On any Resources page, select rows, groups or everything, then use **Labels…** in the floating bar to stage label changes, apply them in one go and undo from the toast.

**Storage forecast in GB-months**: In the Forecast cost column on the Resources and Limits pages, storage is now billed on the month's average size, with the free allowance applied once per account, instead of an inflated month-end projection.

**Saving a token works again**: In Settings ▸ Cloudflare API tokens, Save now stores the token, it appears in the list immediately, and any refusal shows a readable message instead of "[object Object]".
**Encrypted tokens behind Access**: In Settings ▸ Cloudflare API tokens, you can add, replace, test and delete tokens that are stored encrypted and only ever shown as their last four characters.
